book.title: Profet Samuelgo Po Elalubo Buku Si

content: Devitgo te Amon dabe me, Siria dabe me, aiyaba elaluali
Nahas, te Amon dabego king bidi, te isibaso, tama aga ogwa, Hanun, te king pedelali.

Tama Devitgo te tama po wali, “Eno te wiegi yai kolesaga Hanunba yaiba,” wali, “te aga aya, Nahasgo, te enabolo yali kolesaga tiwai gilama yaiba,” wali. Tama tiyu, Devitgo te bidi meba tagala palama, te Hanunba homu dene ebo po wagi pomainu yali. Tiali goli, augwali te buluba sabalubo side,

te Amon bulu tǫ pedai tobolu bidi dabego te augwa kingba te tama tiwai po wali, “Nago homugo Devitgo te bidi dabego te nago ayabolo homu dene eyu, te genuai nogi magasu asali da, homu eyu teba, agawe? Mu menio. Agai augwali tagala palali, te dago hanu taun te bugagia sula selama, tama nosali te aga ami bidi dabe dali aselama, te da dolagasainu yalio,” tama po wali.

Hanungo te po odama, tama agai te Devitgo hani bidi dabe pageabi elama, tama augwaligo penane nisi me badu togolama, tama me badu te elalubadi, tagalali. Tama agai te augwaligo bobage gudali ugwa te togolama, pęwadage mu igulali, te gasa bidi dabego augwaligo tigi habu mi sumainu ebo tiwai ilama, tama agai augwali te augwa buluba tagala palalio.

Tiali goli, te bidi dabe augwa te hale mu ebaso, tama augwa buluba ma pabo te augwa hagela homu yali. Te Devitgo haniba te Hanungo te tama kolesaga yali po odama da, teda agai te bidi dabeba te tama po ola tolali, “Dage te Jerusalemba polo asabo homu kelekele me elamuo. Menio. Dage te Jerikode bidilama, te dagego penane nisi ma holobo si, tama nosali dage asiąo,” wali.

Te Amon dabe augwa koneani, augwa te tiali kolesagade te Devitgo haliga sębe mu ilabo sę yali homu yai. Tama tiyu, te Devit augwali dali hwįagaselama, augwali aiyaba elaluidali homu eyu, augwa te bidi meba te Siria tǫba tagala palama, te Betrehop bulu bidi dabe me, Soba bulu bidi dabe, augwali dali te bomai po dąų walali. Tama te bulu side te ami bidi umabo mu, te 20,000 bidi tagala palu, te Amon dabe dali hwįbode tau sagasomainu tialio. Tama te Amon dabego te Top bulu bidi dabe dali me te bomai po dąų walama, te ami bidi umabo mu, te 12,000 bidi sainu tiali. Tama te Amon dabego te Maka bulu king bidi dali me bomai po dąų walama, te augwali te Devit dali hwįbode tau sabo ami bidi dabe umabo, te 1,000 bidi me abelama, salio.
Te Devitgo te Amon dabego te tama tiwai eyu, te ami bidi dabe sisinibo po odolama, tama agai te Joap dali, te Israel ami bidi dabe tigidali dali tagala palu, te augwaliba boi hwįgi pomainu yali.

Tialima, te Amon dabe te augwa genuai hanu taun, te Raba, te masigigo bagulali obo te tomoba pabo sunumi elalubo pąde te sisinama dolaluali. Tama te Siria dabe me, te Top dabe me, te Maka dabe augwali te kala sili elalubo pesagede wasilama, sisinama bidaluali. Tama tigidaligo te Israel dabe dali hwįainu sisi elalualio.

Joapgo te boi bidi dabe sulama, tama agai koneani, te Israel dabeba augwaligo te si badu bugasa hwįaiba homu yali. Tama tibaso, agai te Israel wiegi yai bomai ami bidi meba nidigili pelama, tama augwali te kala silide bidalubo ami bidi hani dabe bidalubo pąde te augwali wasilali. Tama aga digi te augwali tonaluali.
Tama agai aga ama, Abisai, nigilama, te agai gasa ami bidi dabe tonalumainu nigilali, tama Abisaigo augwali te Amon dabe bidalubo pąde wasilali.

Tialima, Joapgo Abisaibolo te tama po walali, “Te hwįbo hodolama hwįbo sogo, tama nago suali, te Siria dabego da aiyaba elaluabo homu ebaso da, teda dage asu, da tau sagasao. Ma, te Amon dabego dage aiyaba elalueinu ebaso da, teda dago dage tau sagasaiba,” wali.

“Dage wi me elamuo. Dago dena hani bidi me te Godigo dabolo mani hanude homu kone palama, tama dago bomo elama, hwįąo. Tama Genuai Bidigo aga homu wali pelama, tama aga te godolo ebo homu tiwai emainu yao,” Joapgo te aga ama Abisaibolo te po wai.
Tialima, Joap te aga ami bidi dabe dali pelama, te boi hwįgi pobadi, tama te Siria dabe wi pela walio.

Tama te Amon dabego te Siria dabe wi pabo subo sogo, augwali me te Abisaigo hanide wi peyu, tama te augwa taun bagulali obo tomoba pelama, geme duala sigi pali. Tialima, Joapgo te Amon dabe tagalama, te aga ami bidi dabe selama, te Jerusalemba ma geasa palio.
Te Siria dabe augwali te hwįanide te suali, te usu meni yani tiwai yali, tama tialima, augwa ami bidi dabe tigidali i olama, sisinagasalio.

Tama te Soba bulu king bidi Hadatesergo te bidi meba tagala palama, te giliga pedalubo madi, te wę Yufretis elalubo badu bidalubo, te Siria bulu bidi dabe sigi pomainu elama, tama augwali sisinagasali. Tigidali te bulu Helamba sisinama, tama Sobak, te king Hadatesergo polalubo ofisa bidigo, te augwali tonalualio.

Devitgo te Siria dabe te Helamba sisinibo sę ebo po odobaso, tama aga hogodama, te Israel ami bidi dabe tigidali sisinama, tama augwa pelama, te wę Jordan nogelama, tama pelama, te bulu Helamba sabolai. Tama te Siria dabe deliba wasilama, nani bidiyu, tama augwa te Israel dabeba boi hwįbo hodolama, hwįanio.

Tiali goli, te Israel dabego hwįbo te bomo mu elama, tama te Siria dabe augwali pogasa peyu, te augwa bidiboba ma palio. Tama Devit te aga ami bidi dabe daligo te karisde dolalua peyu hwįbo ami bidi dabe te bidi sese hauwa, 700 bidi elali, tama te hosde dualasa peyu hwįbo ami bidi dabe te bidi sese umabo mu, te 40,000 bidi ela muani. Tama augwa te Sobak me elali, te Siria dabe augwa polaluali ofisa bidi, tama aga te hwįani pesagede dolo tede tama isai dao.

Te king Hadatesergo dologode bidali king mebago te tiwai ebo si, te Israel dabego augwali aiyaba elalubo sulama, tama augwa te Israel dabe dali nogo menama, tama augwali dologode bidalio. Tama te Siria dabe te Israel dabede wi mu elama, tama tibaso, augwaligo te Amon dabe tau ma me sabeo.
